svg.title: Six trial baseline/actual-or-forecast pairs and a complete implementation proposal
svg.desc: Status date 2026-10-14. Only requirements and trial access have actual completion records. API 401, 80 duplicate-key candidates and a 3-person-day capacity gap remain unresolved. The 30 implementation entries are an unapproved proposal; decision markers are planned reviews, not approvals. Replan and seek reapproval if prerequisites fail.

svg.text: CRM service rollout — integrated schedule, fictional, as of 2026-10-14

g.aria-label: Date scale, aligned with lower axis

g.text: Baseline = hollow dashed | Actual = solid fill | Forecast = dashed fill (whole task interval)
Risk = late completion or overdue | Warning = future delay or risk | Accent = on-time forecast | Success = on-time completion
Variance = actual/forecast finish minus baseline finish (calendar days, including weekends and holidays) | Status 2026-10-14
Proposal = pale dotted bar | Hollow diamond = planned decision or gate (unapproved, not an actual completion)
